storylines.title: Knicks blow by the Cavaliers in the fourth, win 121-102 for sixth straight victory
storylines.summary: — Jose Alvarado scored a season-high 21 points, Mikal Bridges had a season-best 19 and the New York Knicks rode a blitz by their bench to a 121-102 victory over the Cleveland Cavaliers on Wednesday night that extended their winning streak to six.

storylines.title: Several EuroLeague Teams Looking At Cam Thomas, Jeremy Sochan
storylines.summary: NBA veterans Cam Thomas and Jeremy Sochan have drawn interest from several EuroLeague teams. Thomas is a free agent, while Sochan is playing for the Texas Legends in the G League. Multiple EuroLeague teams reportedly have Thomas on their radar. They see the veteran guard as a prime scoring option. Thomas played in 42 total games last season between the Brooklyn Nets and Milwaukee Bucks. For his career, Thomas has averaged 14.9 points per game. Sochan finished last season with the New York Knicks following a waiver from the San Antonio Spurs. This season, Sochan attended training camp with the Portland Trail Blazers before being waived at the end of the preseason. In five G League games with the Legends, the 6-foot-8 forward is averaging 19.2 points, 7.4 rebounds, 5.2 assists and 1.4 steals per game.
